command: seren agent cloud deployment status 7a00003a-0000-4000-8000-00000000003b -o json
claim: An owner can retrieve the managed employee's observed deployment state and desired lifecycle state as separate values.

scope.statement: Status retrieval for the isolated Seren Harness Test deployment 7a00003a-0000-4000-8000-00000000003b. A pass verifies the requested identity and the documented state fields in the response, not readiness, health, convergence, a successful employee workflow or independently measured runtime state.
scope.entry: seren agent cloud deployment status <deployment-id> -o json
out_of_scope: Starting, stopping or modifying the deployment
Credential approval, Discord readiness, message delivery and answer quality
Judging a running, stopped or failed status as the desired business outcome

basis.reference: serenorg/seren v0.10.0 (37654244e3aa3d955eee762a88bbf697f186c6eb), cli/src/commands/agent.rs cloud_status and cli/src/main.rs CloudDeploymentAction::Status: single seren_cloud_get_deployment GET, JSON output; sdk/openapi/openapi-seren-cloud.json GET /deployments/{id}, DataResponse_CloudDeploymentView.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.

expectation_notes: An observed/desired mismatch is reported verbatim, not treated as malformed: the documented fields have different meanings.
A stopped or failed deployment can pass this retrieval-only test. Health=ok cannot replace either state field or establish readiness.
No live state read was made while defining this case.

criteria.claim: The service returns a deployment response object
criteria.evidence: Exit 0 and a data object; target-not-found fails provisionally; access or unclassified errors stay unverified.

criteria.claim: The response identifies the requested isolated deployment
criteria.evidence: data.id equals the requested deployment UUID.

criteria.claim: Observed status and desired lifecycle are separately present with documented values
criteria.evidence: Synthetic handover scenario. No historical observation, private report or customer outcome is included. Establish new recipient evidence before relying on this case.

status_unavailable.title: Managed employee status could not be retrieved for the requested deployment
status_unavailable.impact: The owner cannot inspect the intended employee state.
unknowns: Whether the target was deliberately removed or access changed
status_unavailable.retest: When authorized, run python -m seren_harness collect seren.managed-employee.status-retrieval --target targets/seren.json.

state_contract.title: Managed employee status response lacks usable documented state fields
state_contract.expected: Separate observed status and desired_lifecycle_state values from the v0.10.0 contract.
state_contract.impact: The owner cannot distinguish the reported runtime state from operator intent.
unknowns: Whether the service contract changed after the pinned CLI specification
state_contract.retest: When authorized, run python -m seren_harness collect seren.managed-employee.status-retrieval --target targets/seren.json.

unverified_always.claim: The reported state independently matches the underlying runtime
unverified_always.follow_up: This case observes a service report only; independent runtime verification requires separately scoped evidence.

unverified_always.claim: The employee is healthy, ready and can reply
unverified_always.follow_up: Use the separately authorized lifecycle journey; no readiness inference is made from status or an extra health field.

unverified_always.claim: The observed runtime state has converged to operator intent
unverified_always.follow_up: A single read reports the two values, not transition progress or correctness.

unverified_always.claim: The exact server build that answered
unverified_always.follow_up: This CLI response contract does not establish a server build.
